about: 판매입력 II 저장 = 매출전표 I 까지 (원본 E040253 2026-10-22 실측: (사)경남주류협회 C004 2 x 300 저장 → 말 없이 거래처만 비움 · 판매조회 회계반영여부 체크 · 판매단가일괄변경 목록에 없음 · 삭제 알림 '- 판매 - 매출전표 I'). 머리에 거래구분 · 판매No. · 적요 없음, 격자에 시리얼/로트 · 적요 열 없음, 아래 회계전표연결 · 웹자료올리기 없음.

shots.name: 재고 3 넣기(API)
steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:Promise.all(['/items','/warehouses','/partners'].map((p) => window.__api('GET', p))).then(([it, wh, pa]) => { const i = it.body.find((x) => x.code === 'QA-PROD'), w = wh.body.find((x) => x.code === 'QA-WH') ?? wh.body[0], c = pa.body.find((x) => x.code === 'QA-CUST'); sessionStorage.setItem('s2r', JSON.stringify({ itemId: i.id, whId: w.id, whCode: w.code, partnerId: c.id })); sessionStorage.setItem('s2rWh', w.code); return window.__api('POST', '/stock/transactions', { itemId: i.id, warehouseId: w.id, type: 'INBOUND', quantity: 3, remark: 'QA재고1' }) }).then((r) => r.status === 200)

expect:(() => { const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('thead th')].map((t) => t.textContent.trim()); return h.includes('품목코드') && !h.includes('시리얼/로트No.') && !h.includes('적요') })()

js:window.__api('GET', '/sales').then((r) => { const t = new Date(); const d = t.getFullYear() + '-' + String(t.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(t.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'); const s = r.body.filter((x) => x.partnerId === JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('s2r')).partnerId).filter((x) => x.saleDate === d && Number(x.totalAmount) === 660).sort((a, b) => b.id - a.id)[0]; sessionStorage.setItem('s2rSale', JSON.stringify(s ? { id: s.id, docNo: s.docNo, refl: s.accountingReflected, conf: s.confirmStatus } : null)); return true })

js:window.__api('POST', '/accounting-reflection/delete-sales-with-journal', { kind: 'SALES', ids: [JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('s2rSale')).id] }).then((r) => { sessionStorage.setItem('s2rDel', String(r.status)); return true })

js:(() => { const c = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('s2r')); return window.__api('POST', '/stock/transactions', { itemId: c.itemId, warehouseId: c.whId, type: 'OUTBOUND', quantity: 3, remark: 'QA재고1 되돌림' }).then((r) => r.status === 200) })()
